replaceBoard.title: Open another board?
replaceBoard.description: Save this project locally if you want to pick it up later. Opening another board replaces the current project and its browser autosave. Your artwork won’t carry over.
replaceBoard.updateDescription: Update the PCB while keeping artwork at its existing positions, or open it as a new project. Save a copy first if you want to keep the current PCB.
